name: Input Group
description: A text field with something attached: a text add-on such as @ or a currency sign, a button such as Subscribe, or both. The field, add-ons and buttons share one height and border, and where two touch their corners are square, so they read as one control. Gray 900 text on White with a Gray 600 border, and a Bougainvillea focus ring.

root.description: The field and whatever is attached to it, side by side.

font.size.$description: Text size in the field and add-ons: 18px, the body text size on a site.

line-height.$description: Line height of the field's and add-ons' text: 28px on 18px text.

placeholder.opacity.$description: Placeholder text opacity, so it reads as lighter than typed text.

transition.duration.$description: How long the field's border and focus ring take to change. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

transition.easing.$description: Easing for the field's border and focus ring changes. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

ring.opacity.$description: Opacity of the field's focus ring, so the page shows through it.

addon.description: Optional text or an icon beside the field, such as @ or a currency sign.

font.size.$description: Text size in the field and add-ons: 18px, the body text size on a site.

line-height.$description: Line height of the field's and add-ons' text: 28px on 18px text.

button.description: An attached Button, in any of the Button's colors. Its colors and type come from the Button contract; the input group sets its padding, border and corners to match the field.
